thread.title: Somewhat Positive News Coverage Somewhat Likely to Impact Apple (AAPL) Stock Price

author: ABMN Staff
title: Somewhat Positive News Coverage Somewhat Likely to Impact Apple (AAPL) Stock Price
text:
[$$] Put down roots: how to grow a garden in a rented home (finance.yahoo.com)
Apple stock traded up $3.29 during trading on Friday, reaching $155.99. The company had a trading volume of 304,498 shares, compared to its average volume of 39,055,480. Apple has a 1-year low of $142.00 and a 1-year high of $233.47. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. The stock has a market capitalization of $753.49 billion, a P/E ratio of 13.10, a P/E/G ratio of 1.48 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the company posted $2.07 EPS. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. Sell-side analysts predict that Apple will post 11.89 EPS for the current year.
Several equities analysts recently commented on AAPL shares. JPMorgan Chase & Co. started coverage on shares of Apple in a research report on Thursday, September 27th. They issued an “overweight” rating and a $272.00 price objective for the company. Macquarie reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $235.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Thursday, September 27th. Nomura reaffirmed a “neutral” rating and issued a $215.00 price objective (up from $210.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday, September 28th. Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research report on Monday, October 1st. Finally, Oppenheimer reaffirmed a “neutral” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, October 1st. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have given a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple presently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and a consensus price target of $195.33.
In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the sale, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available at the SEC website . Insiders own 0.05% of the company’s stock.
